reason: Page-scoped export/save request; Varve exports page content through page nodes and supports PDF/page output, but the report does not establish a missing page-only save contract.

reason: Maintainer reproduces Safari trackpad pinch being slower than ctrl-scroll and later reports substantial improvements; no specific change link is given.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has distinct wheel/pinch input classification and camera navigation, but browser/device-specific performance was not reproduced. No specific code change justified by this thread.

reason: Unreproduced ShareDB/Yjs remote-delete rendering crash; maintainer points to a Yjs example update and reporter later says an alpha fixed it.

reason: Feature request for a bulk “Unlock everything” command; no comments or interaction details specify where it belongs or how page/frame locks should behave.

reason: Request bundles bundled/user-installed font choice with custom color palette asks; one commenter raises handwriting-font fit, but no target font set or workflow is specified.

reason: Reusable master/instance components request is explicitly rolled into collections/library issue #1345.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve's shortcuts and clipboard behavior are integrated into editor actions/input layers rather than gated on displaying panels. This report does not establish a Varve failure.
